title: ErrorDocument
description: What `--json` prints when a command fails.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description:
The program that wrote a document or a file: the title block every `--json` document, every
file `hpr` writes and `hpr --version` carry (ADR-164; the product system's `data.md`: "Every
export carries the designation and version of the tool that made it").

designation.description: Its designation in the FusionSpace product system: `FS-ACHERNAR · SW · TOOL 001`.

command.description: The command that failed; `null` for a usage error, where the command line may name none.

help.description:
What to do about it, each a sentence a person reads, the most useful last; empty when
there is nothing to suggest. The text output writes each as a `help:` line.

kind.description: What kind of failure it is; the exit status says the same.

message.description: What went wrong, for a person.

milestone.description: For `not_available`, the milestone that brings the command, such as `M4.2b`.

ErrorKind.description: What kind of failure an error document reports, with its exit status.

oneOf.description: Exit 1: an input was missing, unreadable or refused.
Exit 2: the command line was wrong.
Exit 3: the command's milestone hasn't come yet.
